dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent O-shaped structures on the mid-dorsal surface exhibit thin, high-intensity perimeters with irregular, jagged outer boundaries and a sharp gradient transition into darker-pigmented interiors. C-shaped structures on the posterior-lateral flank show softer, diffused interior edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Maximum spatial density of high-intensity pixel clusters is located in the anterior/neck region. Core pixel concentrations in the mid-lateral region are more dispersed, forming isolated, solid-color asymmetrical blobs without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli and a prominent mid-lateral blob form an irregular scalene quadrilateral. A secondary triangular relationship is formed by clusters near the posterior-dorsal curve.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark linear indentation is visible on the lower mid-lateral boundary. A small, dark, circular punctate mark is visible on the extreme posterior tip of the visible pelt.
other_distinctive_markers: A vertically-aligned 'figure-eight' formation consisting of two overlapping high-contrast rings is located in the mid-lateral field.
